Where Human Development sits in the whole Bank

Across every World Bank publication — all Global Practices and regions, dated January 2024 onward — People / Human Development (Education, Health, Social Protection) draws 2,788,514 downloads across 2137 publications, 19% of the Bank's total, ranking #2 of 7 practice groups.

Every publication is attributed to its owning unit; the 2723 without an owner tag are classified by title and flagged unverified. The LAC region in depth is on the LAC — All Practices page.

About the counts. Every 2024-onward WB publication, attributed to its owning unit (practice from the unit's name, region from the unit code, e.g. HLCED = LAC Education) plus verified OKR. The 2723 publications with no owner tag are assigned to a practice by title and flagged unverified (filter below); a few may sit in the wrong practice. Some publications carry only a broad anchor unit, so they land in a coarse “(anchor/other)” bucket rather than a fine practice. Reader geography (the map) is WB Documents only. Downloads over time

Grand total at each refresh · updates every 2 months

Methodology & contact

Sources. Downloads are read from both World Bank repositories — WB Documents (documentos.bancomundial.org) and the Open Knowledge Repository (openknowledge.worldbank.org) — and summed across every language version of each publication.

Window. Publications with a document date in 2024–2026. Reader geography is from WB Documents (~99% of its downloads are geo-located; OKR downloads are not). “United States & high-income” is the World Bank's residual region grouping, here almost entirely the United States.

Scope is every 2024-onward World Bank publication (Publications & Research), attributed to its owning unit: the practice from the unit's descriptive name, the region from the unit code (e.g. HLCED = LAC Education, EECPV = ECA Poverty). Counts are WB Documents + verified OKR (matched by title and date). Publications with no owner tag are assigned by title and flagged unverified — author affiliation is not used because the search database does not expose individual authors (it returns institutional authorship). Reader geography is WB Documents only. The searchable list shows the 1,500 most-downloaded; every publication feeds the comparisons above.

Can't find one of your publications, or think a download count is wrong? Email molina@worldbank.org.

Figures refresh monthly (1st of each month) · last checked ECHO is on..

Every WB unit, all Global Practices, publications dated January 2024 onward. WB Documents + verified OKR; reader geography = WB Documents only. Blank-owner pubs classified by title (unverified). Refreshes monthly.
